1 · Intro

When to use it.

Non-exempt employees enter their time and request time off in UKG. When an employee asks why their check looks wrong, the answer is usually on their timecard.

This course shows what employees see so you can talk them through it.

Use this whenA non-exempt employee asks how to enter time, fix a missed punch, approve their timecard, request PTO, or check their balance.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in UKG. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Exempt employees do not use UKG for time off; their time off is managed in Oracle.
  • If time is not approved by employee and manager, non-exempt pay can be delayed. Check time cards weekly.
  • Open item: confirm whether Vanderbilt employees punch at clocks, use web or mobile punch, or enter hours on a timesheet, and which accrual balances display.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • UKG: Approve and sign off your timecard (opens in a new tab)
  • UKG: Request Time Off from My Calendar (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Payroll & Timecards

UKG: Employee Timecards and Time Off

Use when: A non-exempt employee asks how to enter time, fix a missed punch, approve their timecard, request PTO, or check their balance. · System: UKG (Kronos)

  1. Open UKG from Oracle: Me tab > Apps > UKG (Kronos) Timesheets.
  2. Enter or punch time for each day worked.
  3. In an open pay period, Save, don't Submit.
  4. Approve your own timecard when the period is complete.
    • Approval State: Open, Submitted, Approved (PayPrep Ready)
  5. Request PTO: add a row with +, then Browse in the Time Off column for the pay code.
    • 4-hour increments
    • Example pay code: PTO-Vacation
  6. Check accrual balances before requesting time off.

Watch-outs

  • Exempt employees do not use UKG for time off; their time off is managed in Oracle.
  • If time is not approved by employee and manager, non-exempt pay can be delayed. Check time cards weekly.
  • Open item: confirm whether Vanderbilt employees punch at clocks, use web or mobile punch, or enter hours on a timesheet, and which accrual balances display.
